numerical_claims.source_value: EUR 22,1 million total dividend, EUR 1.25 per share
numerical_claims.source_evidence: DIVIDENDS AND DIVIDEND POLICY section states: 'On 28 April 2026, the shareholders of AS Merko Ehitus approved the Supervisory Board’s proposal to the shareholders to pay out the total amount of EUR 22.1 million (EUR 1.25 per share) as dividends from net profit brought forward... paid out on 14 May 2026.'

candidate_sentences.text: During the annual general meeting held in April 2026, shareholders approved a dividend payout of EUR 22.1 million, or EUR 1.25 per share, from retained earnings.

verified_key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance: H1 2026 revenue decreased 10.7% YoY to EUR 150 million (Q2: EUR 92.7 million), net profit decreased to EUR 12.8 million (8.6% margin) in H1 2026 from EUR 21.7 million (12.9%) in H1 2025 (Q2: EUR 8.5 million).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Overview of II Quarter and 6 Months Results; Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income

candidate_sentences.text: During the first six months of 2026, AS Merko Ehitus reported consolidated revenue of EUR 149.9 million, representing a 10.7% decrease compared to the EUR 167.9 million recorded in the same period of 2025.
Net profit attributable to shareholders for the first half of the year fell to EUR 12.8 million from EUR 21.7 million, with the net profit margin decreasing to 8.6% from 12.9%.

verified_key_information_units.information: Secured order book reached an all-time high of EUR 836 million as of 30 June 2026 (up 88% YoY from EUR 444 million as of 30 June 2025).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Secured Order Book section

candidate_sentences.text: A major positive development during the period was the expansion of the group's secured order book, which reached an all-time high of EUR 835.7 million as of June 30, 2026, representing an increase of approximately 88% compared to EUR 443.8 million as of June 30, 2025.

verified_key_information_units.information: Segment performance: Construction services revenue EUR 118.3 million (78.9% of total) with operating profit EUR 3.0 million (2.6% margin); real estate development revenue EUR 31.6 million with operating profit EUR 7.0 million (22.2% margin) in H1 2026.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Business Activities tables, Notes 2 and Reconciliation of Pre-tax Profit

candidate_sentences.text: In the construction service segment, revenue remained relatively stable at EUR 118.3 million for the first six months of 2026 compared to EUR 120.1 million a year earlier, while operating profit for this segment fell significantly to EUR 3.0 million from EUR 8.8 million.

In the real estate development segment, six-month revenue dropped by 33.9% to EUR 31.6 million, and revenue from the sale of own-developed apartments declined to EUR 27.6 million from EUR 44.9 million, accompanied by a decrease in segment operating profit to EUR 7.0 million from EUR 11.9 million.

verified_key_information_units.information: Major project developments: Full-scale construction commenced for the EUR 370 million Rūdninkai defence force campus; EUR 80 million in new contracts signed in Q2 2026 including Krulli quarter infrastructure and buildings in Tallinn.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Commentary from Management and Secured Order Book section

candidate_sentences.text: Group companies signed new construction contracts worth EUR 486.4 million during the first six months of 2026, substantially higher than the EUR 223.1 million signed in the first half of 2025, driven heavily by public sector and defense-related projects such as the Rūdninkai military campus.

verified_key_information_units.information: Real estate development activity: 120 apartments delivered in H1 2026 (vs. 222 in H1 2025); 204 apartments launched; 1,253 apartments under construction/completed with ~40% presold.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Real Estate Development section

candidate_sentences.text: During the first half of the year, the group sold a total of 120 apartments and 5 commercial premises, compared to 222 apartments and 2 commercial premises in the corresponding period of 2025.

verified_key_information_units.information: Market outlook: Construction input price pressures persisted; Vilnius apartment market moderated, Riga saw increased activity in lower-priced segments, Tallinn remained stable with high price sensitivity.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Outlook of Construction and Real Estate Market section

verified_key_information_units.information: Profitability metrics: Pre-tax profit margin fell to 7.2% in H1 2026 (from 14.0% in H1 2025); net profit margin 8.6% (vs. 12.9%); EPS EUR 0.73 in H1 2026 (vs. EUR 1.22 in H1 2025).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Ratios table, Management Report Overview, Note 4

candidate_sentences.text: Pre-tax profit for the first six months of 2026 dropped to EUR 10.8 million from EUR 23.5 million in the prior-year period, resulting in a pre-tax profit margin of 7.2% compared with 14.0% previously.
Net profit attributable to shareholders for the first half of the year fell to EUR 12.8 million from EUR 21.7 million, with the net profit margin decreasing to 8.6% from 12.9%.
Basic and diluted earnings per share for the six-month period were EUR 0.73, down from EUR 1.22 in the first half of 2025.

verified_key_information_units.information: Liquidity position: Cash and cash equivalents increased to EUR 39.6 million (from EUR 25.9 million); equity EUR 251.1 million (57.4% of assets); net debt EUR 29.6 million as of 30 June 2026.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Cash Position section; Consolidated Statement of Financial Position

candidate_sentences.text: As of June 30, 2026, cash and cash equivalents stood at EUR 39.6 million, compared to EUR 25.9 million a year earlier.
Total assets increased to EUR 437.9 million at the end of the first half of 2026 from EUR 403.5 million as of June 30, 2025, while total equity rose to EUR 251.1 million from EUR 242.3 million.
The equity ratio remained strong at 57.4%, and the debt ratio was 15.8%.

verified_key_information_units.information: Dividend payment: EUR 22.1 million (EUR 1.25 per share) approved for 2025 net profit, representing a 55% payout rate.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Dividends and Dividend Policy section, Note 4

candidate_sentences.text: During the annual general meeting held in April 2026, shareholders approved a dividend payout of EUR 22.1 million, or EUR 1.25 per share, from retained earnings.

verified_key_information_units.information: Post-reporting-period event: Construction commenced for 50 apartments in the Lahekalda VII development project in Tallinn after 30 June 2026.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Real Estate Development section

details.completeness_justification: All HIGH-importance criteria (K1-K4, K7-K8) are fully present with core meaning covered. MEDIUM criteria K5 and K9 are also present. K6 (Market outlook) and K10 (Post-reporting-period event) are missing entirely. The summary captures the main picture with no material omissions affecting overall understanding, justifying a score of 4 (Yes).
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent with no material contradictions or logical gaps. All statements are consistent with each other and follow logical relationships. The summary covers revenue, profitability, segment performance, order book growth, financial position, and cash flow developments in a clear organizational structure without unnecessary repetition. While profitability declines are mentioned generally in S3 and then detailed in S4-S6, this is a natural progression rather than a contradiction. The segment figures (S9, S10) are presented without implying they should arithmetically sum to consolidated totals, so no internal contradiction arises from potential reconciliation items. The summary forms a coherent whole with logical cause-effect relationships (e.g., S8 explains reasons for declines) and clear comparisons between periods.
